t2v.rule: Describe scene, action chronology, camera and synchronized audio.

i2v.rule: Images are literal pinned keyframes in the clip, not soft references.

v2v.rule: Continue from start_video audiovisual state and never replay completed action.

draft_enhance.rule: No creative reinterpretation; enhance the selected draft_cache.

productionRules: Do not send generic character/product/place images as FLUX soft reference media in the current public API.
Use one image at 0s as exact Start Frame; two or more timed images as pinned storyboard moments.
Use draft_then_enhance for expensive production exploration.
Treat V2V as short audiovisual continuation context, not arbitrary motion-reference transfer.
